title: Decisions by guardian.
bodyText: Absent a court order to the contrary, a special education decision of a guardian appointed pursuant to chapter 560 takes precedence over that of an agent or educational representative.
bodyHtml: [§302A-495]  Decisions by guardian.  Absent a court order to the contrary, a special education decision of a guardian appointed pursuant to chapter 560 takes precedence over that of an agent or educational representative. [L 2008, c 182, pt of §2]
